quality: Assess source, attribution, language and extraction independently of directional/scope ambiguity. Technical holds cannot be cleared by a component suggestion.
inference: Exact wording is unnecessary when complete local context establishes the actor's own commitment. Reputation, external political assumptions and silence are not evidence.
mixed: Contradictory commitments on the same component, time and scope; conditions or a particular measure restriction alone are not mixed.
quantification: No numeric stance strength or specificity-as-strength. No stance, missing and unresolved remain non-directional/missing; no public scoring migration.
authorization: User prompt adopting component protocol; no label migration/training approval

expression_definitions.explicit: Clear synonyms and ordinary semantic equivalents are explicit. Exact lexical match is unnecessary.
expression_definitions.contextually_implied: Inference from explicitly linked relevant context; record exact basis. Never actor reputation or assumed intentions.
